turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, Hale, and on what basis?
You're welcome. Now answer the question: who decided, and on what basis?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter won that appeal, and she isn't the student we're here about. One more word about Claire and we continue this in the principal's office.
Maybe this runs in the family.
I'm writing that down, word for word. You'll withdraw that sentence and the zero, or the principal hears it from me before five o'clock. Owen. What do you actually have?
